page: Google Cloud Platform e2-standard-2 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the e2 server family. It features 2 vCPUs mapped to 1 physical Intel Xeon core with 2 threads per core, running at a clock speed of 2.2 GHz. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include bundled local storage or dedicated GPU hardware accelerators, and it comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Performance benchmarks position this instance in the lower tiers of compute and memory capabilities. In stress-ng testing, the single-core CPU performance scored 1103.39, while the multi-core score reached 1451.58. Memory bandwidth tests show 79.92 GB/sec for cached small blocks, dropping to 11.77 GB/sec for read-only and 10.27 GB/sec for write operations on large uncached blocks. Geekbench testing yielded a single-core score of 867.0 and a multi-core score of 1025.0, reflecting limited processing throughput for intensive tasks like software compilation or ray tracing.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the e2-standard-2 offers a resource-dense configuration suitable for utility workloads where high-performance compute is not a primary requirement. The hardware profile is optimized for low-demand applications, balancing dedicated CPU allocation with a standard memory footprint. Tradeoffs include lower overall memory bandwidth and weak performance in database operations and cryptographic tasks, as evidenced by a Passmark database score of 826.31 and an encryption score of 2113.08.

This instance is best suited for lightweight general-purpose workloads, including basic web serving, small-scale application hosting, development environments, and low-throughput background utility tasks. It is also capable of handling lightweight text processing and small-scale language model inference, achieving 64.91 tokens per second for text generation on a 135M parameter model.
description: Google Cloud Platform e2-standard-2 is a general-purpose virtual machine featuring 2 vCPUs and 8.0 GB of RAM, powered by an Intel Xeon processor running at 2.2 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance allocates 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled and provides 4.0 GB of memory per vCPU. It contains no local storage or GPU accelerators. Benchmark results indicate modest performance, with a Geekbench single-core score of 867.0 and a multi-core score of 1025.0. Memory bandwidth is limited, reaching 11.77 GB/sec for large uncached reads. Qualitatively, the instance offers a cost-efficient profile for entry-level workloads that do not require high-performance compute or massive memory arrays. It is best suited for lightweight web serving, basic application hosting, small-scale text processing, and development environments.
